title: Ordinal Numbers and Business Dates
completion_message: ¡Fantástico! Has aprendido a usar los números ordinales para hablar de fechas, rangos y posiciones en el contexto corporativo.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Números Ordinales y Fechas

parts.audio: Ordinals: 1st is first, 2nd is second, 3rd is third, 4th is fourth, 5th is fifth, 10th is tenth, 20th is twentieth, 21st is twenty-first.

parts.visual: Usos corporativos: Q1 = the first quarter. The 3rd of October = October third. I am on the 5th floor (Estoy en el 5to piso).
parts.audio: Corporate uses: Q1 is the first quarter. The 3rd of October is October third. I am on the fifth floor.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el ordinal correcto o su forma escrita.

questions.question: My office is on the ____ floor (5).
The ____ item on the agenda is budget. (1st).
This is our ____ year in business. (10th).
The deadline is the ____ of July. (15).
Our company was ____ in the ranking. (3rd).
questions.explanation: Third in the ranking = tercero en el ranking.

questions.question: This is the ____ time we meet. (2nd).
questions.explanation: The second time = la segunda vez.

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The meeting is on March third.
options: The meeting is on March third.
The meeting is on March thirty.
A meeting is on March third.
The meeting was on March third.
questions.correct_answer: The meeting is on March third.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: My office is on the fifth floor.
options: My office is on the fifth floor.
His office is on the fifth floor.
My office is on the fourth floor.
Our office is on the fifth floor.
questions.correct_answer: My office is on the fifth floor.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The first item on the agenda is budget.
options: The first item on the agenda is budget.
The second item on the agenda is budget.
The last item on the agenda is budget.
The first point on the agenda is budget.
questions.correct_answer: The first item on the agenda is budget.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The deadline is the fifteenth of July.
options: The deadline is the fifteenth of July.
The deadline is the fifth of July.
A deadline is the fifteenth of July.
The deadline was the fifteenth of July.
questions.correct_answer: The deadline is the fifteenth of July.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: This is our tenth year in business.
options: This is our tenth year in business.
This is our first year in business.
This is their tenth year in business.
It is our tenth year in business.
questions.correct_answer: This is our tenth year in business.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our company was third in the ranking.
options: Our company was third in the ranking.
Their company was third in the ranking.
Our company is third in the ranking.
Our company was first in the ranking.
questions.correct_answer: Our company was third in the ranking.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: This is the second time we meet.
options: This is the second time we meet.
This is the first time we meet.
That is the second time we meet.
This was the second time we met.
questions.correct_answer: This is the second time we meet.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Today is the twenty-second of February.
options: Today is the twenty-second of February.
Today is the twenty-first of February.
Yesterday was the twenty-second of February.
Today is the twenty-second of March.
questions.correct_answer: Today is the twenty-second of February.
